attempted_claim: Let Q32 = <a,b | a^16=1, a^8=b^2, b^-1 a b = a^-1> (generalized quaternion, order 32) and S = Z[Q32]. Let SK1(S) be the reduced Whitehead group. Fix the prime p = 2, the quaternionic 2-part where Oliver p-elementary/genetic theory is nontrivial. What is the exact order (equivalently exponent) of the 2-primary torsion subgroup SK1(S)(2)? A complete answer gives the integer |SK1(S)(2)| = 2^f, an explicit unit/matrix witness in SL(S) of maximal 2-power order via Oliver genetic-subgroup/defect-quotient computation with a finite replayable certificate, and a bound excluding larger 2-torsion. No trace-detection half is asked.
decisive_failure: No GAP/Magma/PARI/Sage, no internet, and no literature access were available, so the Oliver genetic-subgroup/defect-quotient chain (genetic subgroups, N(S)/S data, 2-adic components, reduced-norm unit cokernels, witness, torsion bound) could not be certified; only routine finite-group computations were completed.
